title: The List and the Lens

mood.label: Uneasy standoff

lines: They called it economic D-Day — oil, gold, shipping, sixty names,
the blockade holds, the allies asked to sign.
And still an envoy in Islamabad says progress, says the memorandum lives,
a half-inch of open door against the line.
Forty-seven years, and Syria is off the list this morning;
Congo counts a hundred days, five thousand cases in.
Thirty dead on a Haitian hill, a drought in Papua burning —
and in five days a new eye opens on the dark we're in.
Forty-two — an uneasy standoff, pressure and small openings,
the sanction and the handshake in the same day's news.
We hold what holds and count what breaks,
and keep the door from closing while we choose.
